Tesla Model Y specs
Hardware 3 uses 8GB LPDDR4 per chip (16GB total) while AI Five targets 96GB memory.
Correction:
- Hardware 3 Lite installed on Hardware 3.
- 3 Lite does not mention pothole avoidance; lists as upcoming improvement for fourteen point three branch.
- Halloween Mode debuting October sixth in update twenty twenty six point thirty eight point three.
Coding team size:
Engineering comprises roughly nine thousand six hundred professional profiles (~16% of company). Lars Moravy oversees more than six thousand engineers/technicians/analysts.
Software/AI team size:
Musk stated around three hundred engineers two hundred on software one hundred on chips plus five hundred data labelers six years ago. Ashok Elluswamy's AI org has grown beyond this to cover FSD Robotaxi Optimus silicon/software groups.
Battery & Range:
User asked how Tesla makes batteries last longer. Answer: It is mostly efficiency not just size. They squeeze more miles out through better thermal management smarter regen braking efficient motors lighter weight refined cell chemistry higher nickel content silicon-anode blends.
Range history:
The Model Y Long Range has hovered around seventy-five to eighty-two kilowatt-hours for years. The Cybertruck offers a one hundred twenty-three kWh pack but that is a truck.
Future plans:
Will they upsize? Probably not as headline move.
